title: A proper locally quasi-finite morphism is finite
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes. If $f$ is proper and locally
quasi-finite in the sense of [pqf-def-quasifinite], then $f$ is finite.
(*Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Tag
[02LS](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02LS), (3) implies (1).*)
